from datetime import date

import pytest

from trialops.eligibility import evaluate_subject


def make_protocol():
    return {
        "min_age": 18,
        "max_age": 30,
        "required_consent_version": "v2",
        "consent_valid_from": "2024-01-01",
        "labs": {"A": [1, 3], "Z": [10, 20]},
        "exclusions": ["DO_NOT_ENROLL", "PRIOR"],
    }


def make_subject():
    return {
        "birth_date": "2000-06-15",
        "consents": [{"version": "v2", "signed_on": "2024-06-15"}],
        "labs": {"A": 2, "Z": 15},
        "flags": [],
    }


def test_same_day_consent_and_inclusive_age_and_lab_boundaries():
    protocol = make_protocol()
    protocol["min_age"] = protocol["max_age"] = 24
    subject = make_subject()
    subject["labs"] = {"A": 1, "Z": 20}

    assert evaluate_subject(subject, protocol, date(2024, 6, 15)) == {
        "eligible": True,
        "reasons": [],
        "consent_version": "v2",
    }


def test_reason_order_and_retired_wrong_consent_version():
    protocol = make_protocol()
    subject = make_subject()
    subject.update(
        birth_date="1970-01-01",
        consents=[{"version": "v1", "signed_on": "2023-12-31"}],
        flags=["PRIOR", "DO_NOT_ENROLL"],
        labs={"Z": 21, "A": 0},
    )

    result = evaluate_subject(subject, protocol, date(2024, 6, 15))

    assert result == {
        "eligible": False,
        "reasons": [
            "CONSENT_MISSING",
            "CONSENT_VERSION",
            "AGE_ABOVE_MAX",
            "EXCLUSION_DO_NOT_ENROLL",
            "EXCLUSION_PRIOR",
            "LAB_A_LOW",
            "LAB_Z_HIGH",
        ],
        "consent_version": "v1",
    }


def test_leap_day_birthday_is_computed_on_the_evaluation_date():
    protocol = make_protocol()
    protocol.update(min_age=24, max_age=24, labs={}, exclusions=[])
    subject = make_subject()
    subject.update(
        birth_date="2000-02-29",
        consents=[{"version": "v2", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"}],
        labs={},
    )

    before_birthday = evaluate_subject(subject, protocol, date(2024, 2, 28))
    on_birthday = evaluate_subject(subject, protocol, date(2024, 3, 1))

    assert before_birthday["reasons"] == ["AGE_BELOW_MIN"]
    assert on_birthday["eligible"] is True


def test_latest_consent_across_versions_never_falls_back_to_older_valid_consent():
    subject = make_subject()
    subject["consents"] = [
        {"version": "v9", "signed_on": "2025-01-01"},
        {"version": "v1", "signed_on": "2024-02-01"},
        {"version": "v2", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"},
    ]

    result = evaluate_subject(subject, make_protocol(), date(2024, 6, 15))

    assert result["consent_version"] == "v1"
    assert result["reasons"] == ["CONSENT_VERSION"]

def test_just_outside_age_and_lab_boundaries():
    protocol = make_protocol()
    protocol["min_age"] = protocol["max_age"] = 24
    subject = make_subject()
    subject["labs"] = {"A": 0.999, "Z": 20.001}

    young = evaluate_subject(subject, protocol, date(2024, 6, 14))
    old = evaluate_subject(subject, protocol, date(2025, 6, 15))

    assert young["reasons"] == ["CONSENT_MISSING", "AGE_BELOW_MIN", "LAB_A_LOW", "LAB_Z_HIGH"]
    assert young["consent_version"] is None
    assert old["reasons"] == ["AGE_ABOVE_MAX", "LAB_A_LOW", "LAB_Z_HIGH"]


def test_consent_signed_after_evaluation_date_is_ignored():
    subject = make_subject()
    subject["consents"] = [{"version": "v2", "signed_on": "2024-06-16"}]

    result = evaluate_subject(subject, make_protocol(), date(2024, 6, 15))

    assert result["reasons"] == ["CONSENT_MISSING"]
    assert result["consent_version"] is None


def test_retired_consent_with_required_version_is_missing_not_version():
    subject = make_subject()
    subject["consents"] = [{"version": "v2", "signed_on": "2023-12-31"}]

    result = evaluate_subject(subject, make_protocol(), date(2024, 6, 15))

    assert result["reasons"] == ["CONSENT_MISSING"]
    assert result["consent_version"] == "v2"


def test_consent_signed_exactly_on_valid_from_is_accepted():
    subject = make_subject()
    subject["consents"] = [{"version": "v2", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"}]

    assert evaluate_subject(subject, make_protocol(), date(2024, 6, 15))["eligible"] is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "target, key, match",
    [
        ("subject", "consents", "subject.consents"),
        ("subject", "flags", "subject.flags"),
        ("protocol", "min_age", "protocol.min_age"),
        ("protocol", "consent_valid_from", "protocol.consent_valid_from"),
        ("protocol", "required_consent_version", "protocol.required_consent_version"),
    ],
)
def test_missing_fields_raise_value_error_naming_field(target, key, match):
    subject, protocol = make_subject(), make_protocol()
    del (subject if target == "subject" else protocol)[key]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=match):
        evaluate_subject(subject, protocol, date(2024, 6, 15))


def test_malformed_consent_date_raises_value_error():

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="signed_on"):
